notes: world_population: HYDE 3.3 (to 1799), Gapminder v7 (1800–1949) and UN WPP 2024 (1950+) as compiled by Our World in Data; 500 BCE uses McEvedy & Jones because HYDE has only 1000-year steps before 0 CE.
population_range: lowest and highest of HYDE and the U.S. Census Bureau's summary of published estimates for that exact year; omitted when only one estimate exists.
world_population is null before 12,000 years ago: no credible census-style estimate exists.
peoples are a curated selection (max 8) of the larger or better-documented groups present at that date, not a complete list. lat/lon mark a representative capital or type site.
2026 figures are UN WPP 2024 medium-variant projections.
